serverInfo.title: Seller Profit Doctor free profit tools
serverInfo.description: Free profit tools for online sellers on Etsy, Shopify and Amazon: a full check-up with a grade word and the top 3 losses (each with its fix and dollar value), Etsy's fees on a sale, one Etsy sale's profit after fees and costs (with pay per hour), Offsite Ads, the shipping gap, Etsy Ads break-even ROAS, the price for a target profit, whether a sale or coupon pays, one sale's fees compared across Etsy, Shopify and Amazon, break-even ROAS for Meta and Google ads, what a box bills at with USPS, UPS and FedEx, Shopify plan fit, the fees on one Shopify order, Amazon's fees on a unit, Amazon ads break-even ACoS, and each platform's dated, sourced fee table.
